_comment: Act 1 territory. pos = seed point on the map (0-1, x east, y south); weight > 1 grows a province. owner: you, free, concord, coven, guild, erased. Output is per day. favors: the stat a governor here needs (7+ = good fit, 3 or less = poor fit); favors_why says why. claim: cost to plant your flag on an unclaimed province next to your land (it needs a governor to go with it).

provinces.name: Hollowmark
provinces.favors_why: A market town runs on talk and favours.
provinces.blurb: A seedy market town nobody legally owns. Now it's yours, which is worse.

provinces.name: Frayed Meadow
provinces.favors_why: Half-eaten land needs someone who will not flinch.
provinces.blurb: Grass grows in half-sentences. You crawled out of the Blank here.

provinces.name: Gutterwoods
provinces.favors_why: The Coven respects people who read the signs.
provinces.blurb: Trees grow from discarded letters. The Coven decides who leaves.

provinces.name: Old Mill Crossing
provinces.favors_why: Somebody has to fix the millrace.
provinces.blurb: The mill still turns. Nobody has seen the miller since the Blank came.

provinces.name: Lampwick Hills
provinces.favors_why: Only a scholar can coax the ink spring.
provinces.blurb: The only place for miles where ink still wells up from the ground.

provinces.name: Saltreed Marsh
provinces.favors_why: The reeds whisper. Steady nerves only.
provinces.blurb: Half the reeds have gone white. The other half are whispering about it.

provinces.name: Gallows Ferry
provinces.favors_why: The Guild only listens to a bigger blade.
provinces.blurb: Guild mercenaries run the river crossing and charge both ways.

provinces.name: Tithe Road
provinces.favors_why: The clerks can be talked round. Slowly.
provinces.blurb: The road to the capital. Concord clerks audit everyone who walks it.

provinces.name: Whitewater
provinces.favors_why: Rewriting erased land is scholar's work.
provinces.blurb: There was a village here. The Blank kept the outline and ate the rest.
